qt: to the Commission Nina Carberry (PPE) Subject:

The current Erasmus+ Regulation (2021–2027) explicitly provides funding for not-for-profit European sport events, supporting initiatives such as the European Sport for All Games, the Special Olympics and other events promoting inclusion, grassroots participation and volunteering. However, the proposed Erasmus+ Regulation for 2028–2034 no longer identifies these events as a standalone funding action, raising concerns about the continuation of this support. Can the Commission clarify whether funding for the organisation of not-for-profit European sport events will continue under Erasmus+ 2028–2034, including through the proposed partnerships for cooperation or sport collaborative alliances, and whether a dedicated funding mechanism will be maintained?
